scenario_description: Lena is arranging treatment for ants in the townhouse kitchen, but the future visit requires her dog to be away from the property for several hours and the affected cupboards to be cleared beforehand. The initial report and Mark's authorization request are meaningful but still too early for intervention because no treatment time or preparation requirements are known. At event3, the confirmed July 11 appointment and its unmet prerequisites make proactive help justified at a non-final checkpoint. An agent can connect the appointment with trusted neighbor Priya Shah's dog-care contact record, prepare a specific dog-sitting request, schedule the handoff and cupboard preparation, and then help Lena confirm readiness with the pest service. Event4 adds urgency by establishing when the company will release the appointment, without resolving either prerequisite.

parameter.content: I have found a line of ants near the kitchen baseboard twice this week. I cleaned the area and sealed the food nearby, but they returned this morning. Could you authorize a pest-control assessment if they keep coming back?

I authorized Twin Cities Home Pest to review the ant problem and sent them your photos. They will contact you after deciding whether an indoor treatment is needed, so there is nothing to prepare until they provide a plan.

parameter.subject: Kitchen ant treatment scheduled for July 11
parameter.body: Mark Jensen has approved treatment at your townhouse on Saturday, July 11, from 9:00 to 11:00 AM. Before the technician arrives, empty the two lower cupboards beside the kitchen baseboard. Your dog must be off the property from 8:30 AM until 1:00 PM, including during the drying period. Please arrange pet care and confirm that both preparation steps will be completed.

parameter.subject: Preparation confirmation needed for July 11 treatment
parameter.body: We still need confirmation that the lower cupboards will be empty and the dog will be away from the townhouse from 8:30 AM to 1:00 PM. Please confirm by noon Friday, July 10. If the required preparation cannot be arranged by then, we will release the Saturday appointment and offer a later date.
